raw_html: [[Acid Arrow#Superior Acid Arrow|Superior Acid Arrow]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Acid Arrow#Superior Acid Arrow|Superior Acid Arrow]]:''' This bow coats your arrows in corrosive acid. A successful hit douses the target in acid causing an additional 16 to 40 damage after two seconds have passed. Each additional hit extends the duration of the acid damage by two seconds.
